_comment: Scenario 1 (Automated Cross-Selling): the CRM's overnight batch, not the
assistant, decides who gets a proactive outbound pitch. Synthetic - the
client has not sent a real target list yet - but the mechanism is real:
app/flows.py::_handle_verification only shows a pitch for a customer_id
listed under "eligibility" here, after they verify. Targets the MASS
segment, per the client's own framing of Scenario 1. name/offer/cta/terms
are in Vietnamese because CampaignBook._body() assembles them directly
